items.title: Inventory and freeze the root Markdown cleanup scope

items.context: Move or archive agent-generated legacy root Markdown files outside the final allowed set. Preserve historical material under docs/koala/legacy/root-markdown when needed, and do not leave KOALA.md or Lattice*.md stubs at repository root.

items.title: Update internal references away from removed root Markdown paths
items.context: Update references that point readers or checks at root KOALA.md, koala-project-overview.md, or root Lattice*.md files. References in migration-history docs may intentionally point to archive locations or describe old root filenames as retired.

items.title: Verify final root inventory and migration safety gates
items.context: Run inventory, reference scans, no-overclaim scans, validate, and convergence checks. The root Markdown inventory must match README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and jek.md only.
